description: Not answering yet: brief=monthly answers from 1 Dec 2026. Until then, such a call is refused before any payment. One chapter of a research brief on the x402 market, in Markdown with every table also as JSON: a category (demand, prices, survival, rivals, proof), a launch at a price (the gap, the price, the odds, rivals near the price, proof at the price), a pay-to address (its listings, its categories), or Agoranome Monthly (seller survival, buyer depth, openings, the Fair Offer index, prices, what moves buyer agents, adoption, the agent registry). Each brief's contents are free. Name the brief and its chapter: category needs category; launch needs category and price (method optional); address needs address; monthly needs edition. Price: brief=category $0.50; brief=launch $1.00; brief=address $0.25; brief=monthly $1.00, in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call; the 402 states the one price of what the arguments ask for. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges that price to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
